$comment: The settings every plugin dialog is built from (plugins/shared/README.md). Each `key` is an option of fins_entry.js computeFins, dotted for a nested one (sway.on -> {sway: {on}}); `default`/`min`/`max`/`step` are in the ENTRY's units, and `percent: true` means show value x 100 (the site's sliders read 0-100). `showIf` names a bool key the control is hidden without. `site` is the matching control id in web/index.html: plugins/shared/tests/options.test.js pins every default, range and choice to it. Not here on purpose: layer height (the host's own setting), placement mode (plugins run Auto), and the site's Custom pad and Support gap fields (hand-typed numbers; the material sets the clearances).

options.label: Material
options.tooltip: The filament you'll print in. PETG fuses to supports much harder than PLA, so PETG loosens the gaps, shrinks the tine bite, and gives the bed pad a gap instead of a bite. PLA keeps the tighter grip.

options.label: Tines
options.tooltip: Tines fuse the support to the part so it grips instead of just propping. Off = plain breakaway wall.

options.label: Tine grip
options.tooltip: How tightly to space the grip tines. Light = fewest marks (default), a per-wall floor keeps grip; Firm = dense comb / max grip for a tippy or tall part.

options.label: Bed pad
options.tooltip: A tilted part rests on an edge and peels off the plate without a pad. Auto: Light, or Sure hold when the part meets the plate on a point or a small round foot. Light: one layer, 0.12mm off the part, peels off like a brim. Sure hold: thicker and tacked into the part, holds harder but is harder to remove.

options.label: Sway braces
options.tooltip: Stand tapered buttress ribs against the upright sides of a tall part, tied on with tines all the way up, so it doesn't drift or wobble as it grows.

options.label: Brace grip from
options.tooltip: Height the brace tines start at. 0 = grip the whole height; raise it to tie on only above where the part starts to move.

options.label: Brace tine spacing
options.tooltip: Vertical distance between brace tines. Smaller = held tighter, more marks on the side. Default 6mm.

options.label: Brace depth
options.tooltip: How far the brace reaches out at the bed, as a share of its height. Deeper = stiffer, more plastic. Default 15%.

options.label: Cutouts
options.tooltip: Cut holes through tall breakaway walls to save filament. The top edge that holds the part, the foot, and the wall's ends stay solid, and every hole has a pointed roof so it prints without bridging. Short walls stay solid.

options.label: Wide-face coverage
options.tooltip: How densely to line a WIDE overhang face with fins. The middle is the anti-sag default; drag LEFT for fewer fins (a small part can go down to one — the readout warns if a broad face then risks sagging), RIGHT for more support. Narrow parts are unaffected.
